title: Linux 核心移植
summary: 以啟動 ABI、平臺描述與核心基準連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect boot abi, platform description and kernel baselines through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 移植目標與 ABI
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「移植目標與 ABI」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop port target and abi through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 目標架構：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「目標架構」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for target architecture.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「目標架構」的資料、控制與時間關係。CPU ISA、ABI 與浮點配置需一致。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對編譯目標與核心設定。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for target architecture. ISA, ABI and floating-point configuration must agree. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check compiler target and kernel configuration. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 核對編譯目標與核心設定。
steps.observationEn: Check compiler target and kernel configuration.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：裝置樹本身會實作全部裝置驅動。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: The devicetree itself implements all device drivers. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「目標架構」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「CPU ISA、ABI 與浮點配置需一致。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit target architecture two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 目標架構的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: CPU ISA、ABI 與浮點配置需一致。
knowledge.textEn: ISA, ABI and floating-point configuration must agree.

knowledge.title: 目標架構的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 核對編譯目標與核心設定。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Check compiler target and kernel configuration. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 RV64 教學配置要求 2 MiB 對齊，實體位置 0x80200000 除以 0x200000 無餘數；0x80300000 餘 1 MiB，需調整。16 MiB 保留區佔 512 MiB RAM 的 3.125%；依選定啟動方式重查規格。
knowledge.textEn: Under an assumed RV64 configuration with 2 MiB alignment, 0x80200000 is aligned; 0x80300000 leaves 1 MiB remainder. A 16 MiB reservation occupies 3.125% of 512 MiB RAM; recheck the chosen boot specification.

quiz.question: 本步審查「目標架構」與整體「Linux 核心移植」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing target architecture within linux kernel porting, which statement or check is supported?
options: CPU ISA、ABI 與浮點配置需一致。
裝置樹本身會實作全部裝置驅動。
一次成功啟動證明所有核心配置都正確。
optionsEn: ISA, ABI and floating-point configuration must agree.
The devicetree itself implements all device drivers.
One successful boot proves every kernel configuration.
quiz.explanation: CPU ISA、ABI 與浮點配置需一致。 核對編譯目標與核心設定。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: ISA, ABI and floating-point configuration must agree. Check compiler target and kernel configuration. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 目標架構：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「核對編譯目標與核心設定。」檢查「目標架構」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for target architecture using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「目標架構」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：核對編譯目標與核心設定。 核對「CPU ISA、ABI 與浮點配置需一致。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for target architecture and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check compiler target and kernel configuration. Check the principle: ISA, ABI and floating-point configuration must agree. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對編譯目標與核心設定。
steps.observationEn: Check compiler target and kernel configuration.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：裝置樹本身會實作全部裝置驅動。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: The devicetree itself implements all device drivers. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「目標架構」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對編譯目標與核心設定。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit target architecture input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.objective: 以「啟動 ABI」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for boot abi.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「啟動 ABI」的資料、控制與時間關係。入口暫存器與 MMU 狀態由契約定義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對假想 bootloader 交接表。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for boot abi. Contracts define entry registers and MMU state. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit a modeled bootloader handoff. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 核對假想 bootloader 交接表。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一次成功啟動證明所有核心配置都正確。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: One successful boot proves every kernel configuration. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「啟動 ABI」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「入口暫存器與 MMU 狀態由契約定義。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit boot abi two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.text: 核對假想 bootloader 交接表。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Audit a modeled bootloader handoff. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

steps.title: 啟動 ABI：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「核對假想 bootloader 交接表。」檢查「啟動 ABI」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for boot abi using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「啟動 ABI」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：核對假想 bootloader 交接表。 核對「入口暫存器與 MMU 狀態由契約定義。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for boot abi and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Audit a modeled bootloader handoff. Check the principle: Contracts define entry registers and MMU state. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對假想 bootloader 交接表。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一次成功啟動證明所有核心配置都正確。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: One successful boot proves every kernel configuration. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「啟動 ABI」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對假想 bootloader 交接表。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit boot abi input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
